notes.title: Card Quest: Remastered - On Hold
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
I hope you are all well.

It's been quite a while since our last Card Quest announcement. More than a year really!
We apologize for that. We have been so busy with Card Survival and life... and admittedly this wasn't an easy announcement to make.

It's been a difficult decision but we will be putting Card Quest: Remastered on hold for the indefinite future.

Our initial plan, almost 2 years ago, had been to release Card Survival and Card Quest Remastered in 2022 and then to keep making games on the Card Survival series while we worked on a new third game unrelated to our previous titles. But then Card Survival got a lot bigger than we thought and also became our first commercially successful game, teaching us many lessons in the process.

Unfortunately, while we have already invested considerable money and time on Card Quest Remastered, we'd still need to invest a lot more before we would be happy releasing it and this leaves us in a difficult position. 
We have thought about releasing a simpler version of Card Quest Remastered, but we wouldn't really be happy charging money for it and knowing ourselves we would just still end up investing lots of time on it anyway.
The truth is that we don't want to delay our third game, nor compromise the Card Survival series.
We are a small team of two and we really can't put in any more work hours at the moment, especially not after this intense last year. 

I know that many of you were looking forward to its release and we're sorry that we weren't able to deliver on that front.
If circumstances ever change or we see a way to make it happen, we'll be happy to get Card Quest Remastered finally out.
For now, we just don't want anyone to be waiting for it!

Take care everyone!

notes.title: Card Quest: Remastered - News
notes.content:
Hello Guys!
Hope you are all well.

This year has been very important for us. We are independent again, we released our second game Card Survival and I had a baby! And all of this was made possible, not in small part by the confidence that we got from the people that enjoyed Card Quest.
So thank you all! :)

The purpose of this announcement however is to inform you all that unfortunately we are going to have to delay the release of Card Quest: Remastered to some unspecified date in 2022.

The reasons for the delay are varied but we could say that in the end it was just a classic case of the planning fallacy.
Releasing two games of this size in one year as a two-man team was probably a silly idea from the beginning. Releasing two games in one year while having a baby was probably even sillier. Plissken (the other half of WinterspringGames) had been wisely weary of giving any dates but I still wanted to give some sort of more tangible date and somehow thought releasing CQ:R for the last months of 2021 would be reasonably safe... oh well!

We can't give any dates for now beyond the fact that this would be a 2022 release (don't want to make the same mistake again!). Of course, as soon as we can get a clearer picture and make some better date proposals we'll make an announcement about it.

Beyond that, Card Quest: Remastered's ideal content list remains the same:

◙ [b]Art Overhaul: [/b]New art (I'm personally working on it to make sure every asset retains the identity of the previous game) and we will include an option to switch to the old graphics, don't worry! :)

◙ [b]Gauntlet Mode: [/b]Big game mode that is almost a new game in itself.

◙ [b]Mod Support:[/b] For player-made campaigns, cards, items and enemies.

◙ [b]Localization: [/b] Spanish, French and German plus as many languages as we can find volunteers for. 

◙ [b]Rebalancing and Bug Fixes.[/b]

We are sorry for the delay, but we promise we'll work as hard as we can to make both Card Survival and Card Quest the best games we can get them to be. :)
Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Important News
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I hope you are all well.
We wanted to let you know that after a few years of hiatus we are now full-time indie developers again.
It's been a long time since our last announcement and as you can imagine we have many things to tell you.

[h2][b]◙◙◙ 1 - Bug Fixes ◙◙◙ [/b][/h2]

First, we've just fixed a few bugs that were stopping the game from registering when a player had gotten all items with the rogue and fighter, as well as a card overlapping issue on the mobile version and a map bug in the undead campaign.
These fixes are already up for the Android version, and will be up on Steam (for both windows and mac) next week.

We are currently in the process of transferring Card Quest to a new publisher, as our old one is closing doors, and this has required us to delete the Card Quest App from IOS and upload it again under the new publisher (as Apple didn't let us do the transfer). This means that unfortunately, old IOS users will not be able to get this patch at the moment. That said however, we will be looking into ways to solve this issue so that old users can still get this last patch if they so want to, which is in all likelihood the last one we'll ever release for Card Quest.


[h2][b]◙◙◙ 2 - Card Quest Remastered ◙◙◙[/b][/h2]

Second, for all the people that have enjoyed Card Quest during the last few years, we are happy to tell you that we're planning on releasing a remastered version of the game for the final months of 2021.
We're still in very early development, so many things might change and there's always the risk that we might need to cut/postpone some features, but if all goes well the new game would be coming with:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27225271/3a64d68c0c05d8872cf43bea0332ed66efeb77df.jpg[/img]

[h3]◙ New Revamped Art:[/h3]
We are replacing Card Quest's old graphics with new more professional ones that will make the game look much better while retaining its spirit. These changes will include a complete replacement of all art assets as well as a redesign of its interface and menus to make them more accessible and aesthetically pleasing.

[h3]◙ Gauntlet Mode:[/h3]
We are adding a new very large game mode that more closely resembles the classic roguelike approach. In it you will be starting with no equipment and will have to go through a very large dungeon, and get a chance to find and buy random loot with which to increase your power. This equipment will however, unlike in the normal campaigns, only last for the current run and reset once you die. This mode is quite large and while it will reuse the equipment and enemies from the 3 classic campaigns it is almost like a completely new game in itself.

[h3]◙ Mod Support:[/h3]
We are currently looking into cost-efficient ways to make Card Quest mod-friendly so that other people can make their own campaigns, enemies and cards. While this is not certain at the moment, in our Ideal version of Card Quest Remastered, this would be one of the features we'd like to include.

[h3]◙ Localisation Support:[/h3]
Many have asked us to translate the game into other languages, unfortunately Card Quest was not prepared for that as we couldn't really do it without a considerable amount of work. For this reason we will be making sure this new Card Quest is prepared for localisation so that adding new languages is an easy thing to do.

[h3]◙ Improved Training:[/h3]
We are going to be reworking our "trainings" to make sure they are more accessible and can convey how to best play Card Quest without making it feel like we are beating the player with a mace until they start "thinking right".

[h3]◙ General Polish:[/h3]
We will be fixing many minor bugs, as well as improving texts and balancing whenever possible.


[h2][b]◙◙◙ 3 - Card Survival ◙◙◙[/b][/h2]

Thirdly, we have a new game to announce, or rather, more like a game series to announce. 
We are calling it: Card Survival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27225271/b1328f8bc02e7472bae882f8e460bbd772c7196a.png[/img]

This series attempts to capture the survival experience you can find in other games and translate it into a card format, trying to take advantage of the features that such a format can bring.
Our idea would be to release different Card Survival games for each type of survival experience (deserted island, below zero, mars mission, zombie apocalypse, etc...). Each game containing 15-30 hours of content (so not as huge as card quest was but still sizeable enough) and each at a very affordable price.

The first in the series is going to be a game called "Card Survival: Stranded Island" and like its name shows will attempt to capture the experience of what it feels like to be stranded on a deserted island.
This game is already in an advanced stage of development and will probably be released on early access at some point in the next 3-4 months.

If all goes well we'll be releasing the next instalment in the series later this same year.


◙◙◙

That should be all for now. 
See you guys in the next announcement!

notes.title: Card Quest version 1.00!
notes.content:
Hello all!

We are proud to announce that Card Quest has officially left Early Access. With this update, we are adding the last remaining end game item for the Mountains dungeon: the Runecrafter's Mask.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27225271/ff30e48cecc5d9ebdd8976995423217c17e5299d.png[/img]

This mask allows you to craft very unique runes in exchange for gold. Activate it during a fight and it will open a shop-type menu at the end of the encounter, where you can buy 3 different runes.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27225271/b26c9ca563aa9852d13f602e81c34b28f4066b66.png[/img]

The game being fully released doesn't mean that we will stop updating it altogether: we will continue to apply balance patches and fix bugs when they appear, only less frequently.

Thanks to all our players for participating in the early access process, your feedback has been very helpful to the development of Card Quest and we appreciate it very much!

Our plans for the future mostly involve releasing the game on other platforms/stores, mainly on GOG and on Android phones. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Weekly Announcement and v081
notes.content:
Hi Guys!

Our weekly version is here.
We have added the new system for the saves. From now on when you go to the main menu and back the game will continue from the last action you had taken instead of from the beginning of the battle.
We have tested everything as much as we could but we´ll keep our eyes open in case there´s a bug that escaped us.

In addition to the saves we have also included some minor balance changes:

[h1]General Changes:[/h1]
- Decreased the price of the Miracle Medicine.

[h1]Rogue Changes:[/h1]
- Armor Penetration now only works for a turn.
- Damage mitigation now only increases hp by 3.
- Remove movement efficiency perk.
- Homemade Poison no longer stacks (poison maker perk).
- Backjab no longer has armor piercing.

[h1]Hunter Changes:[/h1]
- Good eye now only works for 1 turn.

[h1]Wizard Changes:[/h1]
- Fixed Imp Familiar description.
- Made it so that all robes and familiars grant their proper resources even if they are the only source for that resource in the build.

[h1]Fighter Changes:[/h1]
- Fixed a bug with the soul stab (was only drawing on chain).

notes.title: Weekly Announcement and v080
notes.content:
Hello all!

This week we have another smaller update with just balance tweaks and bug fixes.

Behind the scenes we are currently working on a better saving system that will save the game after each action played instead of only at the beginning of each fight, and we'll add it to the game with the next update. We know that it will be somewhat of a change in how the game plays and feels, but we are confident that this new system will really improve the overall experience (don't worry though, it will be fully compatible with the current saving system and you won't have to restart any game when those changes apply).

With that being said, here's the list of this week's changes:

[h1]General Changes:[/h1]
- Lowered Troll Champion´s regeneration.

[h1]Rogue Changes:[/h1]
- Fixed Quick Thinker description.

[h1]Wizard Changes:[/h1]
- Magic Ward Perk now only works when not defending.
- Fixed lightning Aura description.
- Improved some perk descriptions.
- Ring of Shielding now gets its charges less often.
- Fixed a bug with the defensive fog card not lowering enough fire magic.

[h1]Fighter Changes:[/h1]
- Diamond Ring name changed for Gold Ring.

notes.title: Weekly Announcement and v079!
notes.content:
Hello all!

We're glad to announce that despite last week's drawback, we're back to posting our weekly updates!

This week we're adding one new end game item for the Forest dungeon: the Forest Crown

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27225271/1e7a2eeaea25d97919619d90c459d0d2046af7da.png[/img]

This one is useful in two ways: it doubles the XP you earn from beating rooms, and you can use it to chose an animal aspect that will give you various passive buffs depending on your class.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27225271/34fcf9331b7bcff589bc4e40d1d7cd6e6ae4bdd8.png[/img]

On top of that we have a good bunch of balance tweaks and a few bug fixes too, here's the list:

[h1]General Changes:[/h1]
- Fixed many typos.
- Decreased the cost of using the alchemy set to 75.
- Lowered georg the merchants prices.
- Fixed a bug with the Spider Huntress (and other enemies that go into hiding) that caused it to come out of hiding invisible and impossible to target.

[h1]Hunter Changes:[/h1]
- Fixed bug with the hunter not unlocking the demon heart.
- Fixed a bug with the arbalist class not unlocking properly.

[h1]Wizard Changes:[/h1]
- Repulsion Blast now generates arcane charges but no longer stuns unless it's chained.
- Repulsion Blast no longer costs lesss stamina when chained.
- Fixed bug with the Imp Familiar.
- Fixed bug with the Fairy Familiar having the wrong sound.
- Fixed bug with the illusion robes (split image discount).
- Imprison now generates arcane charges (and no longer costs arcane charges) but costs more stamina.
- Dark Ritual now costs 4 hps instead of 2 hp.
- Necromantic mastery perk now only works for the first 3 turns of every battle.
- Raise Undead is now cheaper but summons only half the revenants.

[h1]Fighter Changes:[/h1]
- Fixed a bug with the endless fury perk.
- Fixed description for anger build up perk.

notes.title: Weekly Announcement and v073!
notes.content:
Hi Guys!

Once again, it's time for our weekly version.
This week we're adding new unique items that you can unlock by finishing a level.

As we said before, we're releasing only the City items today, but the other levels will get their items soon.
These items can be used by every character but they need to be unlocked separately for each one, and their effects can vary from one character to the next.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27225271/843b32fa179b7a8e5aca8de829c5bde108a9ed4a.png[/img]

Here's a little peek at what they do:

[h1]Cursed Box[/h1]
This mysterious box doesn't do much on its own, you'll have to open it to unlock its secrets!
It requires you to collect 25 Souls to open it, but it constantly drains 2 Souls per turn.
Be careful when the time comes to open it though, we recommend you try it in a safe situation, you never know what might be inside...

[h1]Shadow Crown[/h1]
The crown of the legendary Shadow King! 
Who knows how the Lich got his hands on it, but it is said that whoever wears it can cheat death itself, if they can prevent the Shadow King from taking it back from them.
This item comes with a very special passive ability, and it has a slightly different use for each hero.

[h1]Alchemy Set[/h1]
With this set equipped, you can spend 100 Gold whenever you want to brew a random potion.
Potions can have all sorts of effects, from just healing a few HP to adding passive perks to your character for the run.
You'll have to try them to find out!


That's it for this week, more endgame items coming for the Mountains and Forest soon!

[i]And we've also fixed a few bugs:
- Fixed the Wizard being able to equip the Swashbuckler/Adventurer subclass
- Fixed a bug where the game would freeze when playing a card with the Poison Kit equipped
- Fixed a bug where the Demonling Subclass could be unlocked by completing any level with the rogue[/i]

notes.content:

notes.content:

[h1]Rogue:[/h1]

notes.title: Version 0.60 is up!
notes.content:
Hi Guys!

A new version is here!
First I wanted to thank you all for the great feedback you've given me with the hunter. :)
I hope you'll be happy with the new things I'm including in this version. Mostly Hunter and Fighter changes. 

For the hunter I've made many changes to improve and balance the class, including changes for the military quiver, the rustic quiver and the sharpshooting school.
For the Fighter I've mostly made some modifications to his Warhammer and Throwing Axes and made some important changes to his Berserker School. 

The Enchanted Forest Dungeon is also progressing nicely. I'm slowly implementing all the new items and cards. This week I've mostly worked on things for the Wizard and the Fighter.

And here's the usual list:


[h1]General Changes:[/h1]
- Enemy Armor icons now show their armor value.
- Improved spawning so that spawner enemies are more likely to stay in the middle of the room.
- Deactived "drag to target" mechanic (so now there's only the original click on card -> click on target mechanic). We might reimplement it again in the future once we have time to make it better, I just wasn't happy with how it was working and it was causing a little bit of confusion..
- Palerat Collective now kills normal palerats to make room for giant ones when it needs to.
- Fixed some typos and bugs and improved many descriptions.
- Increased the chances Draugar and Cultists have of throwing debris/knives when distant.
- Dwarven King know has fury on distance as well.
- High Town now always links to all areas.
- Enemies that don't give souls no longer trigger On Kill effects.


[h1]Fighter Changes:[/h1]
- The inertia effect now also decreases the stamina cost of hammer attacks by 2.
- Throwing Axe now deal more dmg to distant enemies.
- The fighter now deals dmg +2 when enraged.
- Inner rage now grants dmg +2 for the entire turn but can no longer be stacked.
- Berserker Healing has been completely redesigned. It is now a lot more dynamic and works better with the class.


[h1]Hunter Changes:[/h1]
- Unstable shot now has a chance to deal less damage but costs less stamina when on chain.
- Familiar arrow now causes next arrow to cost -2 stamina and draws an additional card.
- Lucky arrow now always deals a base of 2 dmg, and has a chance to deal +10 extra dmg.
- The net is now undodgeable but can only stun for a turn.
- Serrated arrows can now be stacked with another serrated arrow and a different arrow (so that you can now have 3 arrows stacked at the same time as long as 2 of them are serrated arrows).
- Royal Arrows deal less damage now, but cost less, stun and draw a card when shot.
- The Hideout mechanic now works with charges (so it only protects for X attacks), and planned escape gives 2 charges of it.
- Changed how toxicity works: it now caps at 9 and deals dmg at the begining of every battle unless its value is under 6 (the dmg is determined by how intoxicated you are).
- Fixed all bugs with the Sensory Decoction.
- Prepare Shot has become 1 stamina more expensive.
- Fey magic now decreases by 2 points per turn.
- Archer Mail no longer decreases stamina regeneration but max stamina.

This new update includes an improved main menu, improved mechanics for the "Pass" button, other minor features and some Fighter balancing.

On top of that I'd like to tell you that the Hunter is almost ready! If all goes well we should have it for the next update! :)

- Improved the Main Menu: it looks much better now and gives extra information.
- Improved the Pass Button: pass all automatically stops if you're going to receive damage, and can also be manually stopped.
- Enemies destroyed to make room for new spawns no longer give xp nor souls.
- Archlich, Vampire Matriarch, Corpse Mountain, Cursed One and Spider Cocoons now only announce what they're summoning if there's room.
- Fixed bug that caused chests not to open when distant.
- Fixed bug that caused the paladin school and the Warhammer to start unlocked from the begining.
- Fixed a bug that caused the Corpse Mountain (and other bosses) to go off screen.
- High Pyromancer's attack now deals damage over time.


[h1]Wizard Changes:[/h1]
- Increased the cost of the Arcane Disk when not on chain.


[h1]Fighter Changes:[/h1]
- Moved Dwarven Shield to Spider Caves.
- Moved Battle Axe to Goblin Village.
- Moved Throwing Axes to Dwarven City.
- Moved Holy Water to Harpy Nests.
- Lowered the amount of health all armors give.
- Berserker's Enraged state now makes defensive cost +2 stamina instead of +1.
- The Soul Stab now only costs -2 stamina when on chain.

notes.title: Version 0.55 is up!
notes.content:
Hi all!

Here comes a new version!
Our most important addition this time is the new training adventures.
At the moment, only the Wizard and Fighter ones are available. But we'll have the Rogue one for next week. 
These adventures consist of 7 rooms (like a normal area) and are designed to teach some of the basic strategies in Card Quest. They also include new enemies, texts and even a new item at the end of each adventure. This is an experiment, and also a first official iteration. So you can expect these training adventures to improve with time.

Besides that I've also added new rooms to the mountains, some of which contain new characters that can grant blessings when rescued.

Finally, I've also been working on the rogue a lot and nerfing his daggers and swords. The assasination school in particular still needs more balancing but I'll be working on it this week.

- Added new Training Mode.
- Made Mushroom Heart Boss easier (it now has less dmg on contact).
- Added new rooms to the Mountain Pass, Goblin Village, Dwarven City and Spider Caves.
- Added 4 Rune Dwarves that grant special blessings when helped.
- Added 2 new minor items, unlocked by beating the training adventures.


[h1]Rogue:[/h1]

- Decreased dmg for the Vampire Stab.
- Decreased the dmg of the serrated jab.
- Jabs no longer cost less on chain.
- Backstabs no longer draw cards.
- Vampire Stab now only draws 1 card normally, but draws an extra 1 on kill.
- Killer Strike no longer draws a card.
- Decreased the cost of Flurry of Attacks and it now draws 2 extra cards.
- Shadow Cloak no longer decreases Stamina.
- Killing Blow is now a CHAINBREAKER.

notes.title: Version 0.53 is out!
notes.content:
Hi all,
It's this time of the week again!

Balancewise we have some minor changes for the Fighter, mostly for his items, and a lot of balance changes for the Rogue. Specially for the swashbuckling school.

We've also added some new features. You can now receive blessings and catch diseases, things that will give you permanent benefits or penalties but only for your current run. We've only added a couple but we'll be adding more in future versions.
On another topic the game now has cloud saves so you can play from different computers without having to restart from the begining.

We've been working a lot on a new training mode as well. It will consist of 3 minicampaigns, with unique enemies and even minor items to unlock when you beat them. Every room there will consist of a challenge designed to help you learn the strategies and tricks of Card Quest.

Finally, we're also starting to have a lot of art for the Hunter and many of the enemies that you'll find in the Enchanted Forest.

Have a nice week!


[h1]Fighter Changes:[/h1]

- Wine Skin now gives more stamina and draws a card.
- Bear Hide now gives less health.
- Improved Raise Shield Cards Descriptions.
- Made Holy Aura usable on defense too.


[h1]Rogue:[/h1]

- Made Boneblade Block weaken less, decreased its normal dmg and increased its chain dmg.
- Reduced the weakening effect of the Vampire Stab.
- Reduced the weakening effect of the Thirsty Jab.
- Improved Harpy Cloak.
- Decreased the chain stamina cost of Acrobatics.
- Gave armor piercing to Dodge Attack.
- Flurry of attacks costs no stamina now.
- Decreased the stamina cost of lunge.
- Made Killer Strike cheaper when on chain.


[h1]General Changes and Bug Fixes:[/h1]

- Added a couple of Blessings and Curses (minor perks that don't persist accros runs).
- Added a few new enemies and rooms to the Cursed City.
- Added CHAINBREAKER text to the "draw" button.
- Gave the option to cap FPS at 60 or 30 (can be set up in the launcher).
- Implemented Cloud Saves.
- Made a small change to the Unlock screen so that the preview of the currently equipped item doesn't interfere as much with the preview of the new Item.
- Fixed a bug with distance in hidden enemies.
- Fixed typos and improved some descriptions.


Edit: It seems there was a bug in the update that made it impossible for players to start directly from tier 4 areas (which you can do when you have the 3 keys unlocked). As of GMT 20:02, a new version (0.53a) has been uploaded with a fix.

notes.title: Version 0.52 is out!
notes.content:
Hello all!
The weekly version is out!

We have many bug fixes and balance improvements.
Hopefully these will make the wizard feel less overpowered (specially the necromancer) and add more challenge and variety to its gameplay. The game can be beaten with almost any combination of cards, as long as you know how to play them right and have the right items (some decks are harder than others of course). ;)
The Fighter has received a dmg increase for his cards in order to make its battles more agile. Hopefully that will help make the experience more entertaining to those who weren't enjoying him so much.
The rogue has mostly received some minor changes to his swashbuckling school.

For those of you interested in the new dungeon and hero: 
The Hunter has 90% of its Mountain and City unlockables done and I'm starting to draw his art. 
The Forest is 40% done and I'm slowly working on the enemy art as well. Expect lots of fey creatures and beasts, many new scrolls and books for the Wizard,  new axes for the Fighter, new swords for the Rogue and lots of new items!


[h1]Wizard Changes:[/h1]

- Improved Blinkstone, Storm Ring, Ring of Shielding, Arcane Robes, Arcane Channeler and Thunderstones to make them more viable.
- Crow Familiar now informs you of hidden enemies.
- Storm shield now costs 2 arcane charges instead of generating them, but no longer blocks less dmg on chain.
- Soul Armor now only provides 1 armor and 1 dmg on contact with no 
limit as to how many times it can be stacked.
- Zap now stuns.
- Soul Shield now costs 1 soul less when on chain and draws without chain.
- Wraith Guard now stuns and deals considerably more dmg.
- Black Curse no longer weakens.
- Spider Ring now increases your max souls and regenerates uses faster.
- Necromancer Robes now increase your maximum souls and grant more souls on use.
- Vampire Familiar only grants 3 souls now.
- Storm Pulse now costs 1 stamina less and generates an extra arcane charge when 
on chain.
- Made both Lightning Strike and Chain Lightning cost 1 arcane charge less.
- Forcebolt now deals more dmg on chain.
- Arcane Disk now costs less arcane charges and draws without chain.
- Imprison now cost less arcane charges on chain.
- Arcane Shield now blocks without chain.


[h1]Fighter Changes:[/h1]

- Increased dmg of all hacks and stabs (with the exception of the dull ones).
- A new Tactics object has been placed in Burnt Town.
- Cursed Armor has been moved to the Castle.
- Black Sword has been moved to the Roofs.
- Rosary can no longer be found (for now, and of course you keep it if you had it).


[h1]Rogue:[/h1]

- Made Lunge undodgeable.
- Made Flurry of Attacks 1 stamina cheaper.


[h1]General Changes and Bug Fixes:[/h1]

- Stun attacks that deal no dmg no longer break unaware state.
- New enemy: Wraith.
- Added new rooms to Cemetery, Roofs and Cathedral.
- Archlich has been improved to be able to better deal with distant heroes.
- Improved Cave Bear Boss (new art and balance changes).
- New art for adult Dragons.
- Fixed bug with Flurry of Attacks not doing the math right.
- Added warning for trick dodge, countergrab and confusion cards to make them easier to understand for new players.
- Improved enemy forced spawning.
- Fixed bug that made enemies go back to their initial position after receiving dmg on contact, all while still waiting for the player to chose a defense card.
- Many more minor bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Version 0.51 is out!
notes.content:
Hi all! Hope you had a nice week!
We just finished our new version. It has many fixes, balances and new features. 

We've made some important changes to the starting areas of the game. Many players were getting stuck in them and weren't unlocking any new items or cards. Forcing them to grind, which was never something that we wanted.
We reordered many of the unlockables in order to make the starting difficulty curve less abrupt. New card sets will now be faster to unlock (tier 2), and the items unlocked by beating tier 1 areas will be better. Ranged items will also be unlocked faster to make fights with dmg on contact enemies more aproachable.

Because we have reordered the locations of items, some players may find that some areas they had previously beaten will now show an interrogation mark again. That means they still don't have the item available in that location and that if they beat it again they should get it. Those items that have now been moved to a new location that was still not beaten will still remain with those players that have it.



[h1]Changes for the Rogue and Fighter:[/h1]

◙ Rogue:
- Secret Knife is now unlocked by beating Old Town.
- Dagger is now unlocked by beating Alley Town.
- Lucky Penny has been improved and is now unlocked by beating River Town.
- Dwarven Bombs are now unlocked by beating the Old Mines.
- Buckler is now unlocked by beating the Garrison.
- Off-Hand Dagger is now unlocked by beating the Goblin Village.
- Short Sword is now unlocked by beating the Dwarven Tunnels.

◙ Fighter:
- Holy Relic has been improved.
- Wine Skin is now unlocked by beating the Old Town.
- Heater Shield is now unlocked by beating Alley Town.
- Bastard Sword is now unlocked by beating River Town.
- Healing Salves have been improved and are now unlocked by beating Infested Town.
- Chainmail is now unlocked by beating the Garrison.
- A new armor for the Berserker spec can now be unlocked by beating the Mountain's Foot.
- Arming sword is now unlocked by beating the Old Mines.
- Dwarven Ale is now unlocked by beating the Mountain Pass.
- Kite Shield is now unlocked by beating the Dwarven Tunnels.
- Holy Water is now unlocked by beating by the Goblin Village (at least for now).
- The old Leather Armor can no longer be aquired but those lucky players that had it already can keep it. :) 




[h1]Fixed Bugs and new Features:[/h1] 

- The range of defensive cards now indicates the range of their effects on enemies instead of their ability to block ranged attacks.

- Alternate way to discard: right-click twice on a card to discard it.

- Recharge rate and max uses of item are shown in equipment menu and unlocked item menu.

- Adjustments to the "Something's not right" message: it's now appearing in the enemy frame and only appears for static hidden enemies (does not appear when the spider huntress goes into hiding for example).

- Fixed a bug that made the victory jingle play when there were still hidden enemies remaining in the room.

- Fixed more bugs that caused the spider huntress to be targetable when hidden.

- Added many new rooms to add more variety to the starting areas including some with unique new enemies.

- Increased alcohol cap to 9. You still get drunk at alcohol 6 but you can now get heavily drunk if you reach 9.

- Fixed a bug that made tombs spawn double enemies.

- Tuned the Corpse Mountain and High Necromancer bosses.

- Rewrote all enemy descriptions to make sure they had no typos and reflected all their skills properly, including the damage they deal, whether their attacks stun, etc...

- Fixed Typos and minor bugs with: soul mastery, skelfilegur not being stun immune, thankful goblin having the wrong gfxs, wraith collector,  etc...


Note: 23:15 GMT, 07/02/2017 => A patch (v0.51a) fixing an enemy that had the wrong graphics (undead dwarf) has been uploaded.

notes.title: Version 0.50 is out!
notes.content:
Hi all! First we'd like to thank you all for trying our game! We hope you've been enjoying it so far! 

The version we've just released includes a lot of bug and typo fixes as well as some new art and features. We'll continue releasing versions like this as often as possible until the final release version.
Here's what we've done: 

- Improved description of poison/weaken effects on enemies (like Burning or Black Curse): it now shows the duration and damage per turn of the different effects.

- Added extra information on Stat effects like Overheat/Drunk (hover over stats to see the info).

- It is now possible to directly drag and drop cards onto enemies to target them (all cards can be played like that but the ones hitting random targets or all targets will ignore the selected enemy).

- Changes to the Hidden Enemies mechanics: clearing a room that has hidden enemies will no longer end your turn. Instead a "Something's not right..." message will appear, you can still play non-attack cards and the hidden enemies will appear when you end your turn.

- Inanimate objects like Barricades or Spider Webs will now kill themselves automatically if all active enemies in the room are dead (and you still get XP from them).

- On the item unlocked screen, you can check the cards/effects of the item that will be replaced by hovering over the "Replaces X" text.

- Fixed a bug causing the Spider Huntress to still be targetable after hiding.

- Fixed a bug causing the fire projectile to remain on screen after killing a Pyromancer using Scorch.

- Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze for some time upon first launch on some computers.

- Made new art for the Revenenants, Big Revenants, Crawlers, Palerats, Palehounds, Dogs and Wolves. (most of these enemies should now have more variations)

- Fixed many typos and improved many enemy and item descriptions to better reflect their abilities.

- Polished many minor things (healing mushrooms and chest potion effects are now immediate, made dwarven thief stun immune, fixed bug with minecart riders not inheriting their minecart's statuses, etc...)



Edit: It seems the version caused a few items to get locked again (like the holy water or the dwarven tower shield for example). As of 22:05 GMT we have uploaded a new version (0.50a) that has a fix for that. Any item that got locked by that bug should appear unlocked again. :)
